product_scope: all BreakMetric releases with normalized product identity, checklist and odds data
objective: Separate high-frequency market collection from canonical EV evidence so BreakMetric can scale across thousands of card variants without one manual development step per card.

evidence_tiers.description: Exact product/card/parallel realized-sale sample with normal market-record provenance.
Exact product/card/parallel current ungraded value from an approved market-data provider.
Modeled estimate from exact observations for the same subject and card category.
Modeled estimate from category or team medians when exact subject evidence is absent.
No defensible market evidence or model basis is available.

rules: Exact product identity is fail-closed. Topps Chrome Premier League, Topps Chrome Sapphire Premier League and Topps Premier League are distinct products.
Provider current prices are not represented as realized sales and never count as original-marketplace verification.
Modeled C/D estimates are visibly separated from direct market evidence and cannot silently enter canonical EV.
Collector batches use breadth-aware player rotation before economic-priority depth so one player cannot dominate automated research.
Repeated collection is idempotent: unchanged provider data does not rewrite repository data.
Collection failures or missing credentials must not mutate canonical EV or fabricate values.
High-impact cards and ambiguous identities remain eligible for manual exception review.
Tier B candidates must be machine-classified as direct-provider observations; Tier C/D candidates must be machine-classified as modeled values.
Modeled candidates must expose an evidence breakdown separating canonical realized-sale observations from exact provider current-price observations.
Direct-provider candidate EV and modeled candidate EV must be summarized separately; any combined candidate total must be explicitly labeled non-canonical.
